content:
LAREDO — Here is your Webb County week ahead: a rainy, cool start, a warm and sunny midweek, and showers returning for the weekend.

Monday is the wettest day, with showers, a high near 65 and a low near 61. A Flash Flood Warning is in effect until 11 a.m., with a Flood Watch until noon. Rain chances are 50 to 60 percent, and 1 to 2 inches of rain are possible. Tuesday stays cloudy, high near 70, low near 62, with a 20 percent rain chance.

Wednesday, Veterans Day, is cloudy, high near 74, low near 62. Thursday warms up fast: mostly cloudy, high near 80, low near 56. Friday is the best day of the week — sunny, high near 80, low near 61, with only a 10 percent rain chance.

Saturday turns wet again, with showers, a high near 77 and a low near 65, and a 60 percent rain chance. Sunday keeps the showers, high near 75, low near 56, with a 40 percent chance.

Winds stay light to moderate, 5 to 12 mph, shifting from north early in the week to southeast by the weekend. Bottom line: keep the umbrella handy Monday and again Saturday and Sunday; Thursday and Friday are the days to get out and enjoy the sunshine.

Sources:

  • Weather.com — Laredo, TX 10-day forecast
  • National Weather Service — Laredo, TX forecast
